constraints: Every verification command in every plan, afterWave and finalVerification exits 0 once the owning plan's changes are in; no informational or expected-to-fail commands.
Rule ids label-overflow, label-collision, note-overflow stable; BPMN/breadboard lint output and exit codes unchanged.
Fixtures self-authored and generic; no emojis; bun tests with BUN_OPTIONS=--jsx-runtime=classic; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true; no tool attribution in commits.
designDecisionsAndRationale: One combined plan (tll-12) owns the core review, LINT_NO_PAGES and all CLI test updates, so its full bun test packages/core packages/io apps/cli/src gate passes on its own.
tll-13 depends on tll-12 because mise run test-cli runs all of bun test apps/cli/src.
Wide-aware measurement is lint-only in a helper no export path imports, so export output stays byte-identical (user-qa Q2).
Dispatch manifests stay in impl-plans/active with pre-archive planPath values, per impl-plans/README.md convention.
intentionalTradeoffs: East Asian Ambiguous (A) width graphemes are treated as narrow (design line 64, 168).
Existing architecture/freeform/flowchart documents with wide text may get new warning-only findings; export bytes and exit codes are unchanged.
Serial waves (tll-12 then tll-13) trade parallelism for gates that never depend on a later plan.
supportedEdgeCases: node.generic 140x60 with a CJK label -> 'Label line 1 of 1 is 195 wide but the text area is 120 wide at 13px; export clips it.'; same box with a same-length ASCII label -> no finding.
Fixed text.note 120x44 with a 16-grapheme CJK text -> wide-line finding (182 vs 104) and note-overflow height finding (3 lines, 58.8 vs 44).
Freeform and flowchart pages are lintable and selectable via --page and get export warnings; a uml-only document -> EXIT_ERROR with the new LINT_NO_PAGES.
BPMN/breadboard lint output and rule ids unchanged.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Real per-font glyph metrics, kerning and Ambiguous-width locale handling.
UML, ERD, sequence, usecase, state and other page kinds; --element and non-svg/png/pdf export warnings (Q3); export --strict (Q4).
